title: Chapter 513
paragraphs: Chapter 513
Episode 141. Fall (6)
The underground dungeon, the lowest level.
Joshua had been imprisoned here for two days.
His limbs were tied to the wall, and his eyes were unfocused.
His mouth, gagged, couldn't even bite his tongue.
'Can it end like this...?'
But what should he do, and how?
His tied limbs were shackled like those of the nursemaids attending the reserve knights, and the knights he had trusted turned out to be his mother's people, not his.
His siblings, who he had treated closely like Myu and Anne, didn't have the power to save him, and the same was true for the Council of Elders.
He couldn't even pin his hopes on the hunting dogs he had raised outside the family.
There was no way those dogs could break through this underground dungeon, and from the beginning, his hunting dogs didn't have the terrifyingly blind loyalty like Typhoon's children.
The hunting dogs would lose their center and crumble.
Now that he had fallen, the other knights closest to the throne.
Luntia, Diphus, Mary, and Jin. If they personally appealed, there might be a slight chance, but that was absolutely impossible.
Even if his father in the Black Sea learned of this, his mother's orders would never be revoked.
It was also impossible to refuse food and drink and embrace death.
The underground dungeon of Runcandel wasn't a place to kill prisoners.
Whether the target was a human, a dragon, a demon, or anything else, the purpose was to isolate the prisoner in absolute solitude until their sentence was up.
If they refused to eat, they were forced to consume, and suicide was impossible to attempt.
Even the prophet wouldn't be able to get him out of here.
'I can't do anything. I can't rely on anything.'
If there was only one thing to pin his hopes on,
'Mother.'
The very mother who pushed him into this hell, the cruel mother taking action herself.
That was the only way to return to the surface.
Creak...
The sound of the entrance to the lowest level opening in the distance reached his ears.
Joshua adjusted his cloudy gaze and stared at the closed door.
Expecting that when the door opened, his mother would enter.
It was quite some time later that the door to the dungeon where Joshua was opened.
"What a sight, Second Knight... Ah, you're not a knight anymore."
An old, snake-like voice.
It was Jordan Runcandel.
He removed Joshua's gag, clicking his tongue.
"How does it feel to have fallen?"
"Chairman of the Black Sword...!"
"Don't look at me like that. I didn't come here to mock you."
Jordan then untied Joshua's limbs, which were tied to the wall.
"I may not be imprisoned, but I'm in a similar situation as you."
"What do you mean?"
"I mean I've lost all my limbs. I may not have been publicly humiliated like you, but my pride has been trampled to the ground. By the Acting Head."
The Black Sword Association, a punitive force of the family made up of particularly strong members among the elders.
Jordan was no longer their leader.
Although he still held the position of Chairman of the Black Sword, the command had been completely transferred to Rosa.
Of course, originally all the forces of the family were in the hands of the head and acting head, but Jordan could no longer move the Black Sword personally in any situation.
It was because of the Exile Incident.
"Both you and I. We were defeated by the Twelfth Knight."
"Do you want to say that you're here not because you lost to the Twelfth Knight, but because of the Acting Head?"
Joshua couldn't answer.
"Just admit it. We lost. Perfectly."
"...What do you plan to do next, Chairman of the Black Sword?"
"Fortunately, my neck is still intact, so I'll have to plan for the next move. You're asking the obvious. And... aren't you the same?"

"The same... as far as I know, you, Chairman of the Black Sword, have never experienced such a fall. Being treated like less than a bug by your father and barely surviving miserably? Devouring yourself with a vain desire to ultimately become the head? Losing the Black Sword? None of these can even compare to this cold dungeon floor."
Chuckling, Jordan let out a laugh.
"That's one way to think about it. For kids like you."
"Heh, you said you didn't come to laugh. In the end, you just came to comfort yourself by looking at a more miserable loser."
"No, I came here because I envy you."
"What?"
"The Acting Head will soon come to find you."
Joshua's eyes widened.
Now, it seemed that Joshua finally understood the meaning of what Jordan had said so far.
"I came in advance because I was worried that if you show your mother the same pathetic state as you show me now, it might really be the end. "
"My mother... My mother will come for me?"

"Mother, mother, mother. You're fundamentally a mama's boy. It's shameful to share the same family name. I never had a mother like yours. Moreover, my competitor wasn't the Twelfth Knight, but Chiron Runcandel. Once I fell, I spent an age unable to return to the surface."
A bitter smile formed on Jordan's lips.
"Now it's your turn to bear that weight. When I finish my secluded training and return to the world... I hope to see you, having shed your weak shell."
"Secluded training? Do you believe you can make a comeback with that at this point?"
"In the end, what governs martial arts is an overwhelming force that everyone must follow. I, too, have long ignored that fact, merely using the shadow cast by your father as an excuse."
Jordan turned his back.
"Turning hell into purgatory is your responsibility. This is not a word from the Chairman of the Black Sword, but as a fellow family member."
Jordan left the underground dungeon.
And while climbing the stairs, he encountered Rosa descending to the basement.
"Acting Head."
"Did you go down to see the ghosts of the underground dungeon? Did you meet Joshua?"
"Yes."
"You did something unnecessary."
"When parents are cold-hearted, someone in the family should treat them warmly, shouldn't they?"
"Have you regained your confidence now that you've lost everything? You have the audacity to say that."
"I just recalled the essence of our family that I had forgotten."
"If many people hadn't forgotten it from long ago, Runcandel wouldn't be so precarious today."
"You haven't become dull either, Acting Head."
As if amused, Rosa grinned.
"The words of the powerless are just complaints. If you want to damage even my mood, let alone my sword and body, prove it. Finish your despicable sword. That's why I spared your neck."
During the brief time Rosa passed Jordan and entered the basement,
Joshua was recalling the words Jordan had just said and the figure the Black Knight Jane had shown before her death.
-I hope my current state will serve as a lesson.
Jane's last words and the visit from the Chairman of the Black Sword.
They couldn't change the essence of Joshua Runcandel in an instant.
They were just a topic.
As Rosa entered, Joshua straightened his posture.
"Acting Head, you've arrived."
Thud!
Suddenly, Rosa stabbed his right shoulder with the blade of fury.
The flesh tore and blood gushed out.
Following that, a light and swift swing of the sword left a deep cut on Joshua's left shoulder.
Fear returned once again.
A fear of his parents that he had never overcome.
The relentless attacks of his mother, who seemed like she would never let him go, created a new kind of fear.
"Even though you claim to have lost your strength, you can't even react to a sword like this? This speed was easily avoidable even for advanced students."
"Le, leader...!"
"Yes, at least now you dare not call me mother. But is that all? Your sister and younger siblings, who are incomparably more talented than you, would have dodged it."
The wildly swung Fury cut through Joshua's chest this time.
The depth of the blade's penetration was by no means shallow.
"Gah!"

"No, they wouldn't have just dodged it; Runtya, Diphus, Mary, Jin! They wouldn't have screamed like you, but opened their eyes wide and attempted a counterattack. No matter the reason or who was wrong, they would have been stabbed by the sword!"
Squirt!

"And if it were Luna, she would have snatched the Fury and aimed it at my neck instead. Wouldn't she be capable of doing so even after losing her strength? That's why Chiron and I felt so regretful, isn't it?"
The pain of being stabbed and cut by the sword was nothing compared to the terrible torment that Joshua was going through.
It seemed less painful to throw his naked body into a pit of fire.
The pain of comparison and inferiority was truly incomparable.
"What do you want me to do?!"
Joshua, who charged recklessly, had his jaw dislocated and his ribcage destroyed.
It was not a counterattack, but a tantrum.
"Guh, gah."
"Why can't you do that? What I'm asking is why you, the child of prophecy, couldn't do that."
For the first time in his life, Joshua blamed his mother.
"You... you... raised me like this."
"I don't remember raising you like that."
"You're right, you raised me like this!"
"No, I didn't raise you like that."
"And weren't you the one who gave birth to me like this? Luna, Runtya, Diphus, Mary, Jin! You didn't give me the talent like them. It's all your doing...!"

"Talent? Fine, I admit Luna. But do you really think the rest of the kids are more talented than you and locked you up here? You just didn't struggle as much as they did. Even though I gave you so many chances... Ah. Now that I say this, I suppose you'll say those chances were poison?"
Rosa let out a sarcastic laugh.
Joshua was trembling, face down on the ground.
His body, mercilessly slashed and stabbed by Fury, wouldn't listen to him when he tried to stand up.

"I'll admit that too. Now that I see it, the chances I've given you over the past decades seem to be poison. I never knew that just spoon-feeding you would be insufficient. If I had known beforehand that I had to chew the food for you, you might not have been here now."
"What... are... you talking about?"
"Do you really think that on that day, in the Sota Desert, on that important mission... I would have only sent your group of knights and two Black Knights?"
